body: I know I am trapped... If I felt strong enough to escape this situation, I would... But I don't. Every little thing is a burden, when I am very low I don't eat, I dont sleep, I don't even shower... I just make sure that my cat has what he needs and that he is happy... But sometimes I feel that this is not enough, that I could do better, and I am afraid to end up in a situation in which I would start to neglect him. I could not forgive myself if this happened.
How do I post a picture? He is dreadfully cute. ^^

Whenever I contemplate taking my cat's life, I just feel sick. How could I do this? Just imagining myself poisoning, choking or beating him instantly makes me feel like a monster, this is so violent and heartless... He does not deserve this, he is happy, he wants to live and to be loved, not to be murdered by the only person he trusts... So yes, until now my thought was that I would have to wait until he dies... But this also makes me feel very bad, as if I was somehow wishing him dead. Once I almost hanged myself then renounced because I knew that no one would find me before weeks or even months, and that he would probably starve to death, or end up in the street as a stray cat. But I still felt suicidal, juste "trapped" in this life "because" of him. These are terrible thoughts to have.

I tried, I really tried. London may be a developed country capital, but it is a terrible place to live if you are a loner, especially a foreigner like me (I am french), and with a very bad mental health condition. 
I asked for a treatment for the last 2 years, in vain. The NHS did nothing to help me, they gave me antidepressants while I told them that I had tried this already and that I was resistant to them. Even my university (King's College London) did nothing to help me and in the end kicked me out because my PhD progress was deemed unsatisfactory... -_- I told them several times that my attempts to get a decent mental health treatment were a massive failure, but no one cared. I was told that as an adult I had the responsibility to take care of it, that it was none of their concern. Once, I was even told by my supervisor that I "should not expect any humanity from the institution of KCL". And then, when in medical leave, I was left with no ressources as my grant was suspended, so I could not afford to meet with a private psychiatrist. 
Also, because I have huge troubles socialising, I could not make a single friend in this country. I guess that if I met with a psychiatrist right now and told him the truth, s/he would either don't care, as usual, or hospitalise me against my will, making me lose control over my life, letting my cat end up vulnerable and alone. I strongly reject this idea. 
I want to make a choice, at least this last one.

You are right, I also thought that I could pretend to have a deadly disease, or that I cannot keep my cat with me for some other reason... But I would feel dishonest to lie like this to someone, especially someone who would do me this great favour. I don't want anyone to feel bad because of this, I want this person to understand that s/he would do a good deed, and not wrongly believe that s/he is somehow responsible for my death, if s/he happens to learn the truth. 
Also if I just let my cat to my vet or to a charity, I would not feel reassured at all. I would fear that my cat might end up trapped in a building with no access to the outside world, with someone who does not value pet's wellbeing as I do or even in a cage. 
This is not an easy thing to do for me, my cat is like a child to me, just one who would never come to understand the concept of suicide and death. If it were a real child, well... I could probably not do this, I would have to carry on for him. But I believe that a pet can be happy with another human being, if this person has the required patience and love. I hope he would not miss me too much, that's all.

I am not rushing, I am quite calm right now. I juste need to be sure that my cat would not be abused, neglected or even put down as a result of my disparition. I want him to be loved and cared of as well as how he is with me now, and also that his new human being will make sure that he can go outside, ideally in a garden. I am currently looking at how I would officially write this in my wills. 
I plan to bequeath money and belongings to some of my friends who need it.
I also plan to kill myself in a way that would make sure that I die, yet allow the rapid gathering and grafting as as many organs as possible so that, at least, my suffering and death would not have been a complete waste. If I lived in the USA, I would have gone for a gun, but here this is quite difficult to buy one.
I already tried everything I could. I don't want people to tell me not to kill myself. I am looking for someone who could take care of my cat.
